name: Dinner with New Friends
description: The "100 Cities Project" hosts a social dinner at a select local restaurant, offering a unique chance to meet fellow travelers and locals.
longDescription:
This social dinner, part of the "100 Cities Project," brings together individuals from diverse backgrounds for an evening of shared conversation and local cuisine. The project aims to foster connections between travelers and residents in various cities worldwide, creating opportunities for cultural exchange and networking. This particular event in Porto focuses on providing a relaxed setting for participants to engage with one another over a meal.

Attendees can expect a convivial atmosphere at a carefully chosen local restaurant in Mafamude. The evening is designed to be an informal gathering, encouraging open dialogue among guests. The duration of the dinner allows for ample interaction, and the primary language of communication will be English, though participants are welcome to converse in other languages. The event caters to adults interested in meeting new people and experiencing Porto's culinary scene in a social context.

Booking is required to secure a place at this dinner. Further details regarding the exact restaurant location and how to book will be provided upon registration. Mafamude is accessible via public transport, with various bus routes serving the area from central Porto.
